caption: Golden-brown miso broth with floating noodles and green onions sits in a white ceramic bowl on a black tray with an orange rim. Dark green nori and golden-brown chashu pork are present; a white ceramic spoon with a yellow stain rests nearby.

segments_info.text: Black tray with textured surface, rectangular shape, visible orange rim at top edge.
The chashu pork is golden-brown, tender-looking, and slightly curled with a glossy surface.
The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, irregularly shaped, and has a slightly rough surface with visible veins.
The miso broth is golden-brown, glossy, and contains visible noodles and green onions floating on its surface.
White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised, subtly textured rim.
A white ceramic spoon with smooth, glossy surface and slightly worn tip, showing faint yellow stain near base.
